input.query: WITH m AS (SELECT signup_month, sum(n_signups) n, sum(n_activated) k FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT *, k::DOUBLE/n rate FROM m) SELECT *, rate-lag(rate) OVER (ORDER BY signup_month) mom_delta FROM r ORDER BY signup_month

SELECT signup_month, count(*) n, avg(CASE WHEN is_activated AND activation_ts <= signup_ts + INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) activation_14d, avg(CASE WHEN is_activated AND activation_ts <= signup_ts + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) activation_30d FROM dim_users WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month >= '2026-01-01' AND signup_month < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
